purpose: Temporary tests-only remote continuation of the exact715 unstarted files. This is not release qualification or a passing verdict.

derivation.rule: Immutable inventory files minus every completed file in results.jsonl, regardless of pass/fail. No baseline or candidate failure is discarded or relabeled.

completeCurrentInventory.encoding: UTF-8 sorted repository-relative paths, one LF after every path, matching run-test-shard.mjs --shard1/1 --list without its first summary line.

separateAdditions.scope: Already-proven later additions remain separate evidence; they are not silently inserted into the715 continuation.

sharding: Sort the unchanged715 files lexicographically, then index modulo36 equals batch-1. Each batch has at most20 files; each file runs once serially. Checkpoint artifacts are retained after every5 selected files.
limits: Mixed-runtime and failed prior local results retain their original identity; this continuation does not retroactively requalify completed files.
Remote Ubuntu/Node22.22.2 results are a separate environment from local macOS observations.
Incomplete, interrupted, skipped, failed and unstarted evidence must remain explicit. No golden, approval, simulation, test policy or release workflow is changed.

partition.scope: Exact file-path projections from the retained raw inventory and completed ledger identified above. Remote validation proves this committed partition and current file bytes; the original full ledger remains separately retained and is not synthesized as a remote test result.

previousInterruptedRun.scope: All four runners reported shutdown and skipped artifact upload. Console-only partial outcomes remain historical evidence and grant no coverage credit. All715 files remain selected; no large-shard rerun is used.
